subject: Uplift & Capacity Onboarding: Kickoff, QBR Scheduling, and Next Steps
messages:
From: Tom Saunders <tsaunders@elarahealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity uplift request and QBR

Mina,

Hope you’re well. We’re approaching the end of our current 12‑month term and we’ve seen higher than expected usage over the past quarter. Leadership wants to lock in an uplift to our committed capacity and extend the term (18 months preferred) to get a fixed unit price.

Attached is a quick usage summary and a ballpark of the uplift we’re considering. Can we kick off a QBR + renewal planning session next week? Preferred times: Tue/Wed morning Pacific.

High level asks:
- New committed throughput (GPU hours equivalent): +45%
- Term: 18 months with a negotiated blended rate
- Clarify data retention and audit logs for compliance review

I’ve attached the usage spreadsheet. Please loop in any relevant account / legal folks.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Platform Engineering
Elara Health

[Attachment: Elara_Renewal_Request.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift request and QBR

Tom — thanks for the note and the sheet. We’re excited to support the uplift. I’ve looped in Marissa (your CSM lead) and Rishi (AM) to coordinate terms and capacity planning.

Quick responses to your asks:
- We can model an 18‑month blended price tied to the committed uplift. I’ll have a first-pass economics from Rishi by EOD Monday.
- Marissa will propose a QBR window and draft a mutual action plan to capture milestones (onboarding of extra capacity, billing cadence, and success metrics).
- On data retention and audit logs: we can provide SOC‑2 evidence and the audit log report — Marissa, will you attach the standard package?

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal alignment (we’ll confirm pricing + SOW draft) — target Mon 06/18
2) Joint QBR + renewal kick off — Tue 06/19 or Wed 06/20 (30–45m)
3) Sign SOW and schedule onboarding runbook review — target week of 06/24

Tom, what time windows work best Tue/Wed? We’ll send calendar options after internal alignment.

Best,
Mina
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tom Saunders <tsaunders@elarahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift request and QBR

Looping in the pricing scenarios as requested. Quick summary below; attached is a one‑page comparison.

Scenario A — Committed uplift (45%)
- 18‑month term
- 12% blended discount vs current list rate
- Predictable monthly billing, overage at lower tiered rate
- Fast onboarding window: 2 weeks to scale pools

Scenario B — Stepped tiers
- 18‑month term with built in step at month 9 (+20% commit)
- Slightly higher blended rate but lower initial cash commit
- Overage handling: standard pay‑as‑you‑go

I recommend Scenario A for predictable unit cost and simpler onboarding; we can model cashflow-friendly invoices if Elara prefers quarterly prepay.

I’ll prepare a few calendar slots for Tue/Wed and send a Doodle if needed.

Regards,
Rishi
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Pricing_Summary_Elara_1p.pdf (pdf)]
